newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Prolific Czech paediatrician Svejcar dies, aged 99.
newsitem.headline: Prolific Czech paediatrician Svejcar dies, aged 99.

text.p: Czech paediatrician Dr. Josef Svejcar, an internationally-respected author on childhood illness, has died of natural causes, aged 99, the CTK news agency reported on Friday.
It quoted doctors as saying that Svejcar died on Thursday, just five months short of his 100th birthday, after he was admitted to the metabolics unit of Prague's Motol hospital.
Svejcar wrote more than 320 textbooks and studies in Czech, English, German, and Italian on treatments and research into childhood diseases, immunology, nutrition, and alergies.

After more than a half century of active practice, he served as professor emeritus at Prague's Charles University. He was an honorary member of more than 20 medical societies in the United States, Germany, and elsewhere.
